defects.defect: Grounding could not be spot-checked: the org returned REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (TotalRequests) for every query during judging. The six claims checked were Loyalty_Transaction__c fields, the Contact.Pronto_App_Account_Id__c External ID (AskCoworker), the Earn/Order picklist values, writeRequiresMasterRead, the Salesforce Integration license, and the absence of Order_Id__c. None was verified, and no create was confirmed absent. Scores rest on the spec's internal consistency and the eval notes (which confirm Contact.Pronto_App_Account_Id__c exists).

The permission set grants Contact Edit (needed by the master-detail Read/Write setting), which lets the integration user edit standard Contact fields. This is disclosed as a non-blocking risk with a verification case, and no narrower alternative is designed.
